source.author: verg
source.text: Te sine nil altum mens incohat; en age segnis rumpe moras; vocat ingenti clamore Cithaeron Taygetique canes domitrixque Epidaurus equorum et vox assensu nemorum ingeminata remugit.
source.text_original: Te sine nil altum mens incohat; en age segnis / rumpe moras; vocat ingenti clamore Cithaeron / Taygetique canes domitrixque Epidaurus equorum / et vox assensu nemorum ingeminata remugit.
source.text_english: Without you, my mind undertakes nothing lofty; come now, be not slow, break off delay; Cithaeron calls with a mighty shout, and Taygetus’ hounds, and Epidaurus, tamer of horses, and the voice, echoed back by the assent of the woods, bellows again.
